Structure plan related to Street Width and Design.

Planner: Julia Friedman
Planning Staff Recommendation: Approval with Conditions
Applicant Name: Adam Loser


                                        PROJECT DESCRIPTION
The applicant is requesting approval of a Roadway Dedication Plat for the Little Valley Gateway planned
development. As part of the roadway dedication the applicant also seeks a positive recommendation from the
Magna Metro Township Planning Commission to the Magna Metro Township Council to amend the Community
Structure Plan for the Project to increase the planned roadway widths and alter some design elements



                           SITE & VICINITY DESCRIPTION (see attached map)
The property was recently annexed into the Magna Metro Township and was zoned as a PC (Planned Community
Zone). The property is over 200 acres in size and is in the Southwest corner of 3940 South 8400 West, in the
Southwest corner of Magna. Development of the Kennecott Land will be residential projects consisting of various
residential housing products, including single-family detached homes, small cottages, townhomes (attached) and
apartments. The PC (Planned Community) Zone allows up to 1,360 units of residential housing. The School District
intends to develop the School Land with buildings and improvements for public school purposes.
        Request: Roadway Dedication Plat                                            File #: 31003




                                  GENERAL PLAN CONSIDERATIONS
The following goals and objectives of the General Plan relate specifically to this project, the roadway design and
overall layout for the Planned Community:

Goal 2: COMMUNITY
Objective 2.3: Develop a network of physical connections that maximize the number of potential routes between
neighborhoods that improves access to schools, churches, public facilities, and commercial centers.

Goal 5: HOUSING CHOICES
Objective 5.1: Provide sufficient housing for current and future populations that are appropriate, safe, and
affordable for a range of income levels.

Objective 5.4: Encourage residential development that establishes a variety of lot sizes, dwelling types, densities,
and price points, as well as an appropriate balance of owner occupied and rental units.

Goal 6: PUBLIC FACILITIES
Objective 6.2: Encourage development that provides services in a logical, orderly manner such that adequate
streets, water, sewer, drainage facilities, schools, and other essential services can be economically provided.




Roadway Dedication Summary                                                                                 Page 2 of 6

                         ISSUES OF CONCERN/PROPOSED MITIGATION
The proposed street dedication widths and design do not fit within that which was agreed to and adopted with
the Community Structure Plan (CSP) as part of the Development Agreement and the PC Zone. As part of this
request the Magna Metro Township Council would need to approve of the changes in the Community Structure
Plan prior to signature on or recordation of any Plats.

The plan and plat call for roadway dedication of privately held land that is currently not under the control of the
developer. This must be remedied before the plat can record. The private property owners must agree to be part
of this application and be willing to dedicate their land to the proposed roadway, or the current developer must
purchase the land from these other land owners and then dedicate it to Magna Metro Township, or the plans will
be required to be changed to not include the land in the development and plans must be adjusted to meet safety
requirements, ordinances and policies for development on a dead end roadway.

                                      PLANNING STAFF ANALYSIS
Applicant has not provided evidence of UDOT approval for access onto 8400 West. This must be provided before
approval for roadway construction can be given or recordation of the dedication plat can occur.

Plans show subdivision into multiple lots. This does not follow with the prior approval to divide these by meets
and bounds description under the provisions outlined in State law.

The most southernly connection to 8400 South crosses multiple privately-owned parcels. The applicant has not
provided any evidence that they have easements to cross those parcels or that they will be purchasing the land
from the adjacent property owners. This must occur before the plats can be recorded. Alternatively, the adjoining
property owners could join this application by providing signed affidavits consenting to the application and sign
the final Roadway dedication plat.

Approval of Master drainage plan must occur before roadway dedication plat can be approved or recorded (per
development agreement).

Easements may need to be shown for water conveyance to detention ponds until such time that full roadway
system is installed.

The Collector road was only approved for 60' wide as part of the CSP plan. The dedication plat calls out 70 feet in
width. Some local roads are shown at 60' wide, not the 50' as approved in the CSP Plan. This will impact the
minimum lot sizes approved under the PC zone Plan and CSP, and total open space. No details were provided on
how or if this would be mitigated.

Layout of lots and streets does not match with approved CSP plan. Clubhouse has changed locations, etc. A new
CSP plan may need to be submitted and approved before subdividing. Roadway connections to the main collector
roads does not match up with approved CSP Plan.

One of the detention ponds is larger than shown on the approved CSP plan. Unsure how will this affect the
adjacent recreational area required as part of the approved CSP plan.

                             PLANNING STAFF RECOMMENDATION
Planning Staff recommends that the Magna Metro Township Planning Commission approve the Little Valley
Gateway Roadway Dedication Plat subject to the following conditions:

   1.   Comply with all requirements of the Little Valley Gateway Development Agreement and requirements of
        the Magna Metro PC Zone Ordinance.
   2.   That the Magna Metro Township Council approve of the necessary amendments to the Community
        Structure plan for the development of the proposed roadways prior to signature and recordation of the
        roadway dedication plats.
   3.   That the Master Drainage Plan is reviewed and approved by Engineering staff prior to final approval and
        recordation of the Roadway Dedication Plat.
   4.   Post applicable bonds for the installation of the roadways.
   5.   Compliance with all ordinance and policy requirements of the individual reviewers and reviewing agencies
        with respect to the development and installation of the roadways.
